name: clinch
description: The NFL playoff picture, at a glance.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c "#ff6a1a,#4dd8c0" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
